simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זֹהַר (H2096) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: זֹהַר (zôhar) means brilliancy First listed occurrence: Dan 12 3.

definitions.full: H2096. zohar זֹ֫הַר noun [masculine] shining, brightness (Arabic , Late Hebrew זְהוֺר , compare Aramaic זִיהֲרָא ); — absolute Ezek 8:2 ז ׳כְּמַרְאֵה like an appearance of shining (explained, v b, as resembling amber, חַשְׁמַל compare 1:27 ); also construct Dan 12:3 see foregoing.
